decision_rule: Primary comparison uses DFT E/F RMSE plus E/F max error; MAE is secondary and not sufficient for selecting the frontier row.
If fm1.5 improves F max or rattle relaxed fmax without losing the Stage140 E gate, teacher-relax force measure was overweighting noisy/tail local curvature.

If fm2.5 improves physical relaxation while preserving E gate, the current student benefits from more deployment Sobolev mass and Stage142 should increase teacher trajectory volume instead of architecture.
If ew3 improves E RMSE/max but damages F RMSE/max or rattle, energy anchor weight becomes an explicit Pareto knob rather than a universal default.
If all three fail the same physical tail modes, return to representation capacity/projection error: active scalar path rank, edge-relational sketches, or teacher projection diagnostics.
